title: Supplementary Tables S35-S37
manuscript_title: Peripheral-Central Convergence of Macrophage and Microglial Programs in Presbycusis Severity

tables.title: Supplementary Table S35. Full CellChatDB.mouse run summary.
tables.description: Per-age summary of the complete 2,019-interaction CellChatDB.mouse run in GSE274279, including evaluated interactions, nonzero and significant edges, significant ligand-receptor interactions, significant pathways, and permutation settings.
tables.notes: All 2,019 mouse ligand-receptor pairs were evaluated per age. Genes absent from the GSE274279 matrix were represented as all-zero rows so that every database interaction could be tested; such interactions return zero probability.

tables.title: Supplementary Table S36. Significant ligand-receptor interactions in the full CellChatDB.mouse run.
tables.description: Cell-type-resolved significant (permutation p < 0.05) ligand-receptor edges across the three ages.
tables.notes: P values are CellChat permutation values computed from 100 bootstrap replicates and are reported without additional multiple-testing correction.

tables.title: Supplementary Table S37. Pathway-level communication in the full CellChatDB.mouse run.
tables.description: Cell-type-resolved pathway-level communication probabilities aggregated from significant ligand-receptor edges across the three ages.
